documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in manufacturing. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The account is in the 'customer' stage with a score of 80, indicating a strong fit and intent. The customer has already expressed consent and is an existing user in the manufacturing sector. However, they are currently facing an issue with their workflow after a configuration change and have requested support before considering any expansion.

claims.quote: We are an existing customer in manufacturing. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your workflow has stopped following a configuration change, and we appreciate your request to involve support before discussing any expansion. Our support team will be in touch shortly to assist with resolving this issue. In the meantime, if you have any additional details that may help us troubleshoot, please let us know. We look forward to helping you restore your workflow and supporting your needs moving forward.
questions: Can you provide any additional details about the configuration change that caused the workflow to stop?
Have you already contacted our support team, or would you like us to escalate this to them immediately?
uncertainties: The exact nature of the configuration change is not specified, which may affect the support team's ability to troubleshoot quickly.
